BJP Chief Attacks CJP, Calls Opposing Groups 'Virus-Cockroach Parties'

Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) Chief Nitin Naveen has launched a strong attack on the Citizens for Justice and Peace (CJP), referring to opposing groups as 'virus-cockroach parties' and a 'gang that wants to break the country'. Naveen stated that such elements are hollowing out the nation and that BJP workers will teach them a lesson. This marks a significant public statement from the BJP chief regarding the CJP and its associated groups.
